name: ai-seo-toolkit
description: Eight SEO and AI-search workflows: Search Console audit, traffic drop diagnosis, keyword clustering, AI citations, competitor gap, content refresh, schema and article drafts.
long_description:
Turns Claude into an SEO analyst. Attach a Google Search Console export and get a ranked fix list built from measured data: pages one position from page one, queries where your own URLs compete with each other, posts quietly losing clicks, and results people see but never click. Diagnose a traffic drop in cost order, checking whether the page even renders for a crawler before anyone blames an algorithm update. Plus keyword clustering, AI citation optimisation built on Google's published guidance rather than GEO folklore, competitor gap analysis, content refresh audits, schema markup and article drafts.

Pairs with MCP Browser (webmatrices.com/mcpbrowser) for JavaScript-rendered page fetching and Reddit or forum research, though it works without it.
